<p align="justify">
I am a <b>Mechatronics Engineering student</b> at <b>IFSC - Campus Florianópolis</b> and an <b>Industrial IoT (IIoT) Intern</b>, passionate about bridging physical hardware, shop-floor automation, and intelligent data systems.
</p>

<p align="justify">
While traditional data analytics often treats telemetry purely as abstract numbers, my engineering background allows me to <b>understand the physics, kinematics, thermodynamics, and machine dynamics behind each sensor reading</b>. My goal is to build end-to-end industrial intelligence: from physical sensing and reliable telemetry pipelines to time-series storage, predictive machine learning, and actionable operational insights.
</p>
